function highlightRegExp(regexpString) {
  let length = regexpString.length, out = "", i = 0, depth = 0, inClass = !1, paletteNames = highlightRegExp.colors?.length > 0 ? highlightRegExp.colors : highlightRegExpColors, palette = [];
  for (let name of paletteNames) {
    let color = inspect.colors[name];
    if (color)
      palette.push([`\x1B[${color[0]}m`, `\x1B[${color[1]}m`]);
  function writeGroup(start, end, decreaseDepth = 1) {
    let seq = "";
    i++;
    while (i < length && regexpString[i] !== end)
      seq += regexpString[i++];
    if (i < length)
      depth -= decreaseDepth, write(start), writeDepth(seq, 1, 1), write(end), depth += decreaseDepth;
    else
      writeDepth(start, 1, -seq.length);
  function write(str) {
    let idx = depth % palette.length, color = palette[idx] ?? palette[0];
    out += color[0] + str + color[1];
  function writeDepth(str, incDepth, incI) {
    depth += incDepth, write(str), depth -= incDepth, i += incI;
  write("/"), depth++, i = 1;
  while (i < length) {
    let ch = regexpString[i];
    if (inClass)
      if (ch === "\\") {
        let seq = "\\";
        if (i++, i < length) {
          seq += regexpString[i++];
          let next = seq[1];
          if (next === "u" && regexpString[i] === "{") {
            writeGroup(`${seq}{`, "}", 0);
            continue;
          } else if ((next === "p" || next === "P") && regexpString[i] === "{") {
            writeGroup(`${seq}{`, "}", 0);
            continue;
          } else if (seq[1] === "x")
            seq += regexpString.slice(i, i + 2), i += 2;
        }
        write(seq);
      } else if (ch === "]")
        depth--, write("]"), i++, inClass = !1;
      else if (ch === "-" && regexpString[i - 1] !== "[" && i + 1 < length && regexpString[i + 1] !== "]")
        writeDepth("-", 1, 1);
      else
        write(ch), i++;
    else if (ch === "[")
      write("["), depth++, i++, inClass = !0;
    else if (ch === "(") {
      if (write("("), depth++, i++, i < length && regexpString[i] === "?") {
        i++;
        let a = i < length ? regexpString[i] : "";
        if (a === ":" || a === "=" || a === "!")
          writeDepth(`?${a}`, -1, 1);
        else {
          let b = i + 1 < length ? regexpString[i + 1] : "";
          if (a === "<" && (b === "=" || b === "!"))
            writeDepth(`?<${b}`, -1, 2);
          else if (a === "<") {
            i++;
            let start = i;
            while (i < length && regexpString[i] !== ">")
              i++;
            let name = regexpString.slice(start, i);
            if (i < length && regexpString[i] === ">")
              depth--, write("?<"), writeDepth(name, 1, 0), write(">"), depth++, i++;
            else
              writeDepth("?<", -1, 0), write(name);
          } else
            write("?");
        }
    } else if (ch === ")")
      depth--, write(")"), i++;
    else if (ch === "\\") {
      let seq = "\\";
      if (i++, i < length) {
        seq += regexpString[i++];
        let next = seq[1];
        if (i < length) {
          if (next === "u" && regexpString[i] === "{") {
            writeGroup(`${seq}{`, "}", 0);
            continue;
          } else if (next === "x")
            seq += regexpString.slice(i, i + 2), i += 2;
          else if (next >= "0" && next <= "9")
            while (i < length && regexpString[i] >= "0" && regexpString[i] <= "9")
              seq += regexpString[i++];
          else if (next === "k" && regexpString[i] === "<") {
            writeGroup(`${seq}<`, ">");
            continue;
          } else if ((next === "p" || next === "P") && regexpString[i] === "{") {
            writeGroup(`${seq}{`, "}", 0);
            continue;
          }
        }
      writeDepth(seq, 1, 0);
    } else if (ch === "|" || ch === "+" || ch === "*" || ch === "?" || ch === "," || ch === "^" || ch === "$")
      writeDepth(ch, 3, 1);
    else if (ch === "{") {
      i++;
      let digits = "";
      while (i < length && regexpString[i] >= "0" && regexpString[i] <= "9")
        digits += regexpString[i++];
      if (digits)
        write("{"), depth++, writeDepth(digits, 1, 0);
      if (i < length) {
        if (regexpString[i] === ",") {
          if (!digits)
            write("{"), depth++;
          write(","), i++;
        } else if (!digits) {
          depth += 1, write("{"), depth -= 1;
          continue;
        }
      let digits2 = "";
      while (i < length && regexpString[i] >= "0" && regexpString[i] <= "9")
        digits2 += regexpString[i++];
      if (digits2)
        writeDepth(digits2, 1, 0);
      if (i < length && regexpString[i] === "}")
        depth--, write("}"), i++;
      if (i < length && regexpString[i] === "?")
        writeDepth("?", 3, 1);
    } else if (ch === ".")
      writeDepth(ch, 2, 1);
    else if (ch === "/")
      break;
    else
      writeDepth(ch, 1, 1);
  if (writeDepth("/", -1, 1), i < length)
    write(regexpString.slice(i));
  return out;

function identicalSequenceRange(a, b) {
  for (let i = 0;i < a.length - 3; i++) {
    let pos = ArrayPrototypeIndexOf.@call(b, a[i]);
    if (pos !== -1) {
      let rest = b.length - pos;
      if (rest > 3) {
        let len = 1, maxLen = @min(a.length - i, rest);
        while (maxLen > len && a[i + len] === b[pos + len])
          len++;
        if (len > 3)
          return { len, offset: i };
  return { len: 0, offset: 0 };

              if (typeof tempNum === "bigint")
                tempStr = formatBigIntNoColor(tempNum, inspectOptions);
              else if (typeof tempNum === "symbol")
                tempStr = "NaN";
              else
                tempStr = formatNumberNoColor(Number(tempNum), inspectOptions);
              break;
            }

              tempStr = inspect(args[++a], inspectOptions);
              break;
            case 111:
              tempStr = inspect(args[++a], {
                ...inspectOptions,
                showHidden: !0,
                showProxy: !0,
                depth: 4
              });
              break;
            case 105: {
              let tempInteger = args[++a];
              if (typeof tempInteger === "bigint")
                tempStr = formatBigIntNoColor(tempInteger, inspectOptions);
              else if (typeof tempInteger === "symbol")
                tempStr = "NaN";
              else
                tempStr = formatNumberNoColor(NumberParseInt(tempInteger), inspectOptions);
              break;
            }
            case 102: {
              let tempFloat = args[++a];
              if (typeof tempFloat === "symbol")
                tempStr = "NaN";
              else
                tempStr = formatNumberNoColor(NumberParseFloat(tempFloat), inspectOptions);
              break;
            }

              a += 1, tempStr = "";
              break;

function detectCommand(query, anyAndAllMeanIn) {

      case "\f":

          case "where":
            return 3 /* where */;
          case "set":
            return 2 /* updateSet */;
          case "in":
            return 4 /* in */;
          default: {

          }

          quoted = !quoted;
          continue;
        }

        return 0 /* insert */;
      case "update":
        return 1 /* update */;
      case "where":
        return 3 /* where */;
      case "set":
        return 2 /* updateSet */;
      case "in":
        return 4 /* in */;

      case "all":
        return anyAndAllMeanIn ? 4 /* in */ : -1 /* none */;
      default:
        return -1 /* none */;
  return command;

function commandToString(command, lastToken) {

function parseUrl(input) {

    return new URL(input);

      url.port = part;
      continue;

      url.hostname = part;
      continue;
    if (part.startsWith("/")) {
      url.pathname = part;

      url.port = hostname;

      url.hostname = hostname;

      url.pathname = `/${pathnames.join("/")}`;
  return url;

        case 1:
          value = @String(value[0]), isArray = !1;
          break;
        default:
          if (isStrictSingleValueField)
            throw @makeErrorWithCode(76, `Header field "${key}" must only have a single value`);
    else
      value = @String(value);
    if (!isArray)
      assertNoNulInValue(key, value);
    if (isStrictSingleValueField) {
      if (singles.has(key))
        throw @makeErrorWithCode(76, `Header field "${key}" must only have a single value`);
      singles.add(key);
    let flags = neverIndex.includes(key) ? kNeverIndexFlag : kNoHeaderFlags;
    if (key[0] === ":") {
      let err = validatePseudoHeaderValue(key);
      if (err !== @undefined)
        throw err;
      if (isArray)
        assertNoNulInValue(key, `${value}`);
      pseudoHeaders += `${key}\x00${value}\x00${flags}`, count++;
      return;
    if (!checkIsHttpToken(key))
      throw @makeErrorWithCode(122, "Header name", key);
    if (isIllegalConnectionSpecificHeader(key, value))
      throw @makeErrorWithCode(329, `HTTP/1 Connection specific headers are forbidden: "${key}"`);
    if (isArray) {
      for (let j = 0;j < value.length; ++j) {
        let val = @String(value[j]);
        assertNoNulInValue(key, val), headers += `${key}\x00${val}\x00${flags}`;
      count += value.length;
      return;
    headers += `${key}\x00${value}\x00${flags}`, count++;
  if (ArrayIsArray(arrayOrMap))
    for (let i = 0;i < arrayOrMap.length; i += 2) {
      let key = arrayOrMap[i], value = arrayOrMap[i + 1];
      if (value === @undefined || key === "")
        continue;
      processHeader(key, value);
  else {
    let keys = ObjectKeys(arrayOrMap);
    for (let i = 0;i < keys.length; ++i) {
      let key = keys[i], value = arrayOrMap[key];
      if (value === @undefined || key === "")
        continue;
      processHeader(key, value);
  return [pseudoHeaders + headers, count];
  assertValidPseudoHeader,
  assertValidPseudoHeaderTrailer,
  buildNgHeaderString

function initStreamingBackpressure(stream) {
  let state = getQuicStreamState(stream);
  if (state.highWaterMark === 0)
    state.highWaterMark = kDefaultHighWaterMark;
  if (state.writeDesiredSize === 0)
    state.writeDesiredSize = state.highWaterMark;
function waitForDrain(stream) {
  let { promise, resolve } = PromiseWithResolvers(), prevDrain = stream[kDrain];
  return stream[kDrain] = () => {
    stream[kDrain] = prevDrain, resolve();
  }, promise;
async function writeBatchWithDrain(handle, stream, batch) {
  if (getQuicStreamState(stream).writeDesiredSize === 0) {
    if (await waitForDrain(stream), stream.destroyed)
      return !0;
  if (handle.write(batch) === @undefined) {
    if (!stream.destroyed)
      stream.destroy(@makeErrorWithCode(129, "Stream write failed"));
    return !0;
  return !1;
async function consumeAsyncSource(handle, stream, source) {
  handle.initStreamingSource(), initStreamingBackpressure(stream);
    let normalized = streamFrom(source);
    for await (let batch of normalized) {
      if (stream.destroyed)
        return;
      if (await writeBatchWithDrain(handle, stream, batch))
        return;
    handle.endWrite();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!stream.destroyed)
      stream.destroy(err);
    else
      throw err;
async function consumeSyncSource(handle, stream, source) {
  handle.initStreamingSource(), initStreamingBackpressure(stream);
  let iter = streamFromSync(source)[SymbolIterator]();
    while (!0) {
      if (stream.destroyed)
        return;
      let { value: batch, done } = iter.next();
      if (done)
        break;
      if (await writeBatchWithDrain(handle, stream, batch))
        return;
    handle.endWrite();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!stream.destroyed)
      stream.destroy(err);
    else
      throw err;

      return ERR_QUIC_ENDPOINT_CLOSED("Start failure", status);

  async sendDatagram(datagram, encoding = "utf8") {
    if (assertIsQuicSession(this), this.#isClosedOrClosing)

    if (length === 0)
      return kNilDatagramId;
    if (length > maxDatagramSize)
      return kNilDatagramId;

      });

  [kFinishClose](errorType, code, reason, errorName) {
    if (code === 0n) {
      debug("finishing closing the session with no error"), this.destroy();
      return;
    if (debug("finishing closing the session with an error", errorType, code, reason, errorName), this.#inner.selfInitiatedClose) {
      this.destroy();
      return;
    switch (errorType) {
      case 0:
        this.destroy(makeQuicError("ERR_QUIC_TRANSPORT_ERROR", "QUIC transport error", "transport", code, reason, errorName));
        break;
      case 1:
        this.destroy(makeQuicError("ERR_QUIC_APPLICATION_ERROR", "QUIC application error", "application", code, reason, errorName));
        break;
      case 2:
        this.destroy(ERR_QUIC_VERSION_NEGOTIATION_ERROR());
        break;
      case 3:
        this.destroy();
        break;
      default:
        this.destroy(makeQuicError("ERR_QUIC_TRANSPORT_ERROR", "QUIC transport error", "transport", code, reason, errorName));
        break;

function findSuitableEndpoint(wantHttp) {
  for (let endpoint of endpointRegistry)
    if (!endpoint.destroyed && !endpoint.closing && !endpoint.busy) {
      let mode = endpoint[kClientHttp];

      if (endpoint.listening)

function processEndpointOption(endpoint, reuseEndpoint = !0, forServer = !1, wantHttp = !0) {

function processIdentityOptions(identity, label) {
  let { keys, certs, verifyPrivateKey = !1 } = identity;
  if (certs !== @undefined) {
    let certInputs = ArrayIsArray(certs) ? certs : [certs];

      if (!isArrayBufferView(cert) && !isArrayBuffer(cert))
        throw @makeErrorWithCode(112, `${label}.certs`, ["ArrayBufferView", "ArrayBuffer"], cert);
  let keyHandles = [];
  if (keys !== @undefined) {
    let keyInputs = ArrayIsArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
    for (let key of keyInputs)
      if (isKeyObject(key)) {
        if (getKeyObjectType(key) !== "private")
          throw @makeErrorWithCode(113, `${label}.keys`, key, "must be a private key");
        ArrayPrototypePush(keyHandles, getKeyObjectHandle(key));
      } else
        throw @makeErrorWithCode(112, `${label}.keys`, "KeyObject", key);
  return validateBoolean(verifyPrivateKey, `${label}.verifyPrivateKey`), {
    __proto__: null,
    keys: keyHandles,
    certs,
    verifyPrivateKey

function setupPreview(repl, contextSymbol, bufferSymbol, active) {
  if (process.env.TERM === "dumb" || !active)
    return { showPreview() {}, clearPreview() {} };
  let inputPreview = null, previewCompletionCounter = 0, completionPreview = null, hasCompletions = !1, wrapped = !1, escaped = null;
  function getPreviewPos() {
    let displayPos = repl._getDisplayPos(`${repl.getPrompt()}${repl.line}`), cursorPos = repl.line.length !== repl.cursor ? repl.getCursorPos() : displayPos;
    return { displayPos, cursorPos };
  function isCursorAtInputEnd() {
    let { cursorPos, displayPos } = getPreviewPos();
    return cursorPos.rows === displayPos.rows && cursorPos.cols === displayPos.cols;
  let clearPreview = (key) => {
    if (inputPreview !== null) {
      let { displayPos, cursorPos } = getPreviewPos(), rows = displayPos.rows - cursorPos.rows + 1;
      moveCursor(repl.output, 0, rows), clearLine(repl.output), moveCursor(repl.output, 0, -rows), inputPreview = null;
    if (completionPreview !== null) {
      let move = repl.line.length !== repl.cursor, pos, rows;
      if (move)
        pos = getPreviewPos(), cursorTo(repl.output, pos.displayPos.cols), rows = pos.displayPos.rows - pos.cursorPos.rows, moveCursor(repl.output, 0, rows);
      let totalLine = `${repl.getPrompt()}${repl.line}${completionPreview}`, newPos = repl._getDisplayPos(totalLine);
      if (newPos.rows === 0 || pos && pos.displayPos.rows === newPos.rows)
        clearLine(repl.output, 1);
      else
        clearScreenDown(repl.output);
      if (move)
        cursorTo(repl.output, pos.cursorPos.cols), moveCursor(repl.output, 0, -rows);
      if (!key.ctrl && !key.shift) {
        if (key.name === "escape") {
          if (escaped === null && key.meta)
            escaped = repl.line;
        } else if ((key.name === "return" || key.name === "enter") && !key.meta && escaped !== repl.line && isCursorAtInputEnd())
          repl._insertString(completionPreview);
      completionPreview = null;
    if (escaped !== repl.line)
      escaped = null;
  function showCompletionPreview(line, insertPreview) {
    previewCompletionCounter++;
    let count = previewCompletionCounter;
    repl.completer(line, (error, data) => {
      if (count !== previewCompletionCounter)
        return;
      if (error) {
        debug("Error while generating completion preview", error);

function findExpressionCompleteTarget(code) {

          }
          break;

      function drainBatch() {
        if (pendingBytes <= BATCH_HWM) {
          let batch = pending;
          return pending = [], pendingBytes = 0, batch;

        while (pending.length > 0 && batchBytes < BATCH_HWM) {

          batch.push(buf), batchBytes += len, pendingBytes -= len;
        }
        return batch;

          if (batch === null) {
            processSyncInput(Buffer.alloc(0), finishFlag);
            while (pending.length > 0)
              yield drainBatch();
            continue;
          }

function getCIDR(address, netmask, family) {

function onServerStream(Http2ServerRequest, Http2ServerResponse, stream, headers, flags, rawHeaders) {
  let server = this, request = new Http2ServerRequest(stream, headers, @undefined, rawHeaders), response = new Http2ServerResponse(stream);

    if (!server.emit("connect", request, response))
      response.statusCode = HTTP_STATUS_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, response.end();
    return;
  if (headers.expect !== @undefined) {
    if (headers.expect === "100-continue")
      if (server.listenerCount("checkContinue"))
        server.emit("checkContinue", request, response);
      else
        response.writeContinue(), server.emit("request", request, response);
    else if (server.listenerCount("checkExpectation"))
      server.emit("checkExpectation", request, response);
    else
      response.statusCode = HTTP_STATUS_EXPECTATION_FAILED, response.end();
    return;
  server.emit("request", request, response);

function headerValueIsUnsendable(value) {
  if (@isArray(value)) {
    for (let i = 0;i < value.length; i++)

  return !1;
function stripInvalidWhitespaceFields(rawheaders) {

function receivedValueLabel(value) {
  if (value === null)
    return "null";

function toRemoteObject(arg) {
  switch (typeof arg) {
    case "string":
      return { type: "string", value: arg };
    case "number":
      if (Object.is(arg, -0))
        return { type: "number", unserializableValue: "-0", description: "-0" };

        type: "number",
        unserializableValue: @String(arg),
        description: @String(arg)
      };
    case "boolean":
      return { type: "boolean", value: arg };
    case "undefined":
      return { type: "undefined" };
    case "bigint":
      return {
        type: "bigint",
        unserializableValue: `${arg}n`,
        description: `${arg}n`
      };
    case "symbol":
      return { type: "symbol", description: @String(arg) };
    case "function":
      return {
        type: "function",
        description: Function.prototype.toString.@call(arg)
      };
    default:
      if (arg === null)
        return { type: "object", subtype: "null", value: null };
      return {
        type: "object",
        description: Object.prototype.toString.@call(arg)
      };

    let path = bindings.path;
    for (let [k, v] of Object.entries(preopens)) {
      let real = fs.openSync(v, nodeFsConstants.O_RDONLY), newfd = this.getUnusedFileDescriptor();
      this.FD_MAP.set(newfd, {
        real,
        filetype: WASI_FILETYPE_DIRECTORY,
        rights: {
          base: RIGHTS_DIRECTORY_BASE,
          inheriting: RIGHTS_DIRECTORY_INHERITING
        },
        fakePath: k,
        path: v
      });
    let getiovs = (iovs, iovsLen) => {
      this.refreshMemory();
      let { view, memory } = this, { buffer } = memory, { byteLength } = buffer;
      if (iovsLen === 1) {
        let ptr = iovs, buf = view.getUint32(ptr, !0), bufLen = view.getUint32(ptr + 4, !0);
        if (bufLen > byteLength - buf)
          console.log({
            buf,
            bufLen,
            total_memory: byteLength
          }), bufLen = Math.min(bufLen, Math.max(0, byteLength - buf));
        try {
          return [new @Uint8Array(buffer, buf, bufLen)];
        } catch (err) {
          throw console.warn("WASI.getiovs -- invalid buffer", err), new WASIError(WASI_EINVAL);
        }
      let buffers = [];
      buffers.length = iovsLen;
      for (let i = 0, ptr = iovs;i < iovsLen; i++, ptr += 8) {
        let buf = view.getUint32(ptr, !0), bufLen = view.getUint32(ptr + 4, !0);
        if (bufLen > byteLength - buf)
          console.log({
            buf,
            bufLen,
            total_memory: byteLength
          }), bufLen = Math.min(bufLen, Math.max(0, byteLength - buf));
        try {
          buffers[i] = new @Uint8Array(buffer, buf, bufLen);
        } catch (err) {
          throw console.warn("WASI.getiovs -- invalid buffer", err), new WASIError(WASI_EINVAL);
        }
      return buffers;
    }, CHECK_FD = (fd, rights) => {
      let stats = stat(this, fd);
      if (rights !== BigInt(0) && (stats.rights.base & rights) === BigInt(0))
        throw new WASIError(WASI_EPERM);
      return stats;
    }, RESOLVE_PATH = (stats, guestPath) => {
      if (!stats.path)
        throw new WASIError(WASI_EINVAL);
      let rel = @String(guestPath);
      while (rel.length !== 0 && (rel.charCodeAt(0) === 47 || rel.charCodeAt(0) === 92))
        rel = rel.slice(1);
      let base = path.resolve(stats.path), resolved = path.resolve(base, rel), isContained = (parent, child) => child === parent || child.startsWith(parent.endsWith(path.sep) ? parent : parent + path.sep);
      if (!isContained(base, resolved))
        throw new WASIError(WASI_ENOTCAPABLE);
      let realBase = base;
      try {
        realBase = fs.realpathSync(base);
      } catch {}
      let probe = resolved, suffix = "";
      for (;; ) {
        let real;
        try {
          real = fs.realpathSync(probe);
        } catch {
          let parent = path.dirname(probe);
          if (parent !== probe) {
            suffix = path.sep + path.basename(probe) + suffix, probe = parent;
            continue;
          }
          real = probe;
        }
        if (!isContained(realBase, real + suffix))
          throw new WASIError(WASI_ENOTCAPABLE);
        return resolved;
    }, CPUTIME_START = Bun.nanoseconds(), timeOrigin = Math.trunc(performance.timeOrigin * 1e6), now = (clockId) => {
      switch (clockId) {
        case WASI_CLOCK_MONOTONIC:
          return Bun.nanoseconds();
        case WASI_CLOCK_REALTIME:
          return Bun.nanoseconds() + timeOrigin;
        case WASI_CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID:
        case WASI_CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID:
          return Bun.nanoseconds() - CPUTIME_START;
        default:
          return null;
    this.wasiImport = {
      args_get: (argv, argvBuf) => {
        this.refreshMemory();
        let coffset = argv, offset = argvBuf;
        return args.forEach((a) => {
          this.view.setUint32(coffset, offset, !0), coffset += 4, offset += @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer).write(`${a}\x00`, offset);
        }), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      },
      args_sizes_get: (argc, argvBufSize) => {
        this.refreshMemory(), this.view.setUint32(argc, args.length, !0);
        let size = args.reduce((acc, a) => acc + @Buffer.byteLength(a) + 1, 0);
        return this.view.setUint32(argvBufSize, size, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      },
      environ_get: (environ, environBuf) => {
        this.refreshMemory();
        let coffset = environ, offset = environBuf;
        return Object.entries(this.env).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          this.view.setUint32(coffset, offset, !0), coffset += 4, offset += @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer).write(`${key}=${value}\x00`, offset);
        }), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      },
      environ_sizes_get: (environCount, environBufSize) => {
        this.refreshMemory();
        let envProcessed = Object.entries(this.env).map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}\x00`), size = envProcessed.reduce((acc, e) => acc + @Buffer.byteLength(e), 0);
        return this.view.setUint32(environCount, envProcessed.length, !0), this.view.setUint32(environBufSize, size, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      },
      clock_res_get: (clockId, resolution) => {
        let res;
        switch (clockId) {
          case WASI_CLOCK_MONOTONIC:
          case WASI_CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID:
          case WASI_CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID: {
            res = BigInt(1);
            break;
          }
          case WASI_CLOCK_REALTIME: {
            res = BigInt(1000);
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!res)
          throw Error("invalid clockId");
        return this.view.setBigUint64(resolution, res), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      },
      clock_time_get: (clockId, _precision, time) => {
        this.refreshMemory();
        let n = now(clockId);
        if (n === null)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        return this.view.setBigUint64(time, BigInt(n), !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      },
      fd_advise: wrap((fd, _offset, _len, _advice) => (CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_ADVISE), WASI_ENOSYS)),
      fd_allocate: wrap((fd, _offset, _len) => (CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_ALLOCATE), WASI_ENOSYS)),
      fd_close: wrap((fd) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, BigInt(0));
        return fs.closeSync(stats.real), this.FD_MAP.delete(fd), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_datasync: wrap((fd) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_DATASYNC);
        return fs.fdatasyncSync(stats.real), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_fdstat_get: wrap((fd, bufPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, BigInt(0));
        if (this.refreshMemory(), stats.filetype == null)
          throw Error("stats.filetype must be set");
        return this.view.setUint8(bufPtr, stats.filetype), this.view.setUint16(bufPtr + 2, 0, !0), this.view.setUint16(bufPtr + 4, 0, !0), this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr + 8, BigInt(stats.rights.base), !0), this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr + 8 + 8, BigInt(stats.rights.inheriting), !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_fdstat_set_flags: wrap((fd, flags) => {
        if (CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_FDSTAT_SET_FLAGS), this.wasiImport.sock_fcntlSetFlags(fd, flags) == 0)
          return WASI_ESUCCESS;
        return WASI_ENOSYS;
      }),
      fd_fdstat_set_rights: wrap((fd, fsRightsBase, fsRightsInheriting) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, BigInt(0));
        if (fsRightsBase = BigInt.asUintN(64, fsRightsBase), fsRightsInheriting = BigInt.asUintN(64, fsRightsInheriting), (stats.rights.base | fsRightsBase) > stats.rights.base)
          return WASI_EPERM;
        if ((stats.rights.inheriting | fsRightsInheriting) > stats.rights.inheriting)
          return WASI_EPERM;
        return stats.rights.base = fsRightsBase, stats.rights.inheriting = fsRightsInheriting, WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_filestat_get: wrap((fd, bufPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_FILESTAT_GET), rstats = this.fstatSync(stats.real);
        if (this.refreshMemory(), this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.dev), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.ino), !0), bufPtr += 8, stats.filetype == null)
          throw Error("stats.filetype must be set");
        return this.view.setUint8(bufPtr, stats.filetype), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.nlink), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.size), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, msToNs(rstats.atimeMs), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, msToNs(rstats.mtimeMs), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, msToNs(rstats.ctimeMs), !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_filestat_set_size: wrap((fd, stSize) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_FILESTAT_SET_SIZE);
        return fs.ftruncateSync(stats.real, Number(stSize)), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_filestat_set_times: wrap((fd, stAtim, stMtim, fstflags) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_FILESTAT_SET_TIMES), rstats = this.fstatSync(stats.real), { atime: atim, mtime: mtim } = rstats, n = nsToMs(now(WASI_CLOCK_REALTIME)), atimflags = WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM | WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM_NOW;
        if ((fstflags & atimflags) === atimflags)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        let mtimflags = WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM | WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM_NOW;
        if ((fstflags & mtimflags) === mtimflags)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM)
          atim = nsToMs(stAtim);
        else if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM_NOW) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM_NOW)
          atim = n;
        if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM)
          mtim = nsToMs(stMtim);
        else if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM_NOW) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM_NOW)
          mtim = n;
        return fs.futimesSync(stats.real, new Date(atim), new Date(mtim)), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_prestat_get: wrap((fd, bufPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, BigInt(0));
        return this.refreshMemory(), this.view.setUint8(bufPtr, WASI_PREOPENTYPE_DIR), this.view.setUint32(bufPtr + 4, @Buffer.byteLength(stats.fakePath ?? stats.path ?? ""), !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_prestat_dir_name: wrap((fd, pathPtr, pathLen) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, BigInt(0));
        return this.refreshMemory(), @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer).write(stats.fakePath ?? stats.path ?? "", pathPtr, pathLen, "utf8"), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_pwrite: wrap((fd, iovs, iovsLen, offset, nwritten) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_WRITE | WASI_RIGHT_FD_SEEK), written = 0;
        return getiovs(iovs, iovsLen).forEach((iov) => {
          let w = 0;
          while (w < iov.byteLength)
            w += fs.writeSync(stats.real, iov, w, iov.byteLength - w, Number(offset) + written + w);
          written += w;
        }), this.view.setUint32(nwritten, written, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_write: wrap((fd, iovs, iovsLen, nwritten) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_WRITE), IS_STDOUT = fd == WASI_STDOUT_FILENO, IS_STDERR = fd == WASI_STDERR_FILENO, written = 0;
        return getiovs(iovs, iovsLen).forEach((iov) => {
          if (iov.byteLength == 0)
            return;
          if (IS_STDOUT && this.sendStdout != null)
            this.sendStdout(iov), written += iov.byteLength;
          else if (IS_STDERR && this.sendStderr != null)
            this.sendStderr(iov), written += iov.byteLength;
          else {
            let w = 0;
            while (w < iov.byteLength) {
              let i = fs.writeSync(stats.real, iov, w, iov.byteLength - w, stats.offset ? Number(stats.offset) : null);
              if (stats.offset)
                stats.offset += BigInt(i);
              w += i;
            }
            written += w;
          }
        }), this.view.setUint32(nwritten, written, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_pread: wrap((fd, iovs, iovsLen, offset, nread) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_READ | WASI_RIGHT_FD_SEEK), read = 0;
        outer:
          for (let iov of getiovs(iovs, iovsLen)) {
            let r = 0;
            while (r < iov.byteLength) {
              let length = iov.byteLength - r, rr = fs.readSync(stats.real, iov, r, iov.byteLength - r, Number(offset) + read + r);
              if (r += rr, read += rr, rr === 0 || rr < length)
                break outer;
            }
          }
        return this.view.setUint32(nread, read, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_read: wrap((fd, iovs, iovsLen, nread) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_READ), IS_STDIN = fd == WASI_STDIN_FILENO, read = 0;
        outer:
          for (let iov of getiovs(iovs, iovsLen)) {
            let r = 0;
            while (r < iov.byteLength) {
              let length = iov.byteLength - r, position = IS_STDIN || stats.offset === void 0 ? null : Number(stats.offset), rr = 0;
              if (IS_STDIN) {
                let getStdin = this.getStdin;
                if (getStdin != null) {
                  if (this.stdinBuffer == null)
                    this.stdinBuffer = getStdin.@call(this);
                  if (this.stdinBuffer != null) {
                    if (rr = this.stdinBuffer.copy(iov), rr == this.stdinBuffer.length)
                      this.stdinBuffer = void 0;
                    else
                      this.stdinBuffer = this.stdinBuffer.slice(rr);
                    if (rr > 0)
                      this.lastStdin = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).valueOf();
                  }
                } else {
                  if (this.sleep == null && !warnedAboutSleep)
                    warnedAboutSleep = !0, console.log("(cpu waiting for stdin: please define a way to sleep!) ");
                  try {
                    rr = fs.readSync(stats.real, iov, r, length, position);
                  } catch {}
                  if (rr == 0)
                    this.shortPause();
                  else
                    this.lastStdin = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).valueOf();
                }
              } else
                rr = fs.readSync(stats.real, iov, r, length, position);
              if (stats.filetype == WASI_FILETYPE_REGULAR_FILE)
                stats.offset = (stats.offset ? stats.offset : BigInt(0)) + BigInt(rr);
              if (r += rr, read += rr, rr === 0 || rr < length)
                break outer;
            }
          }
        return this.view.setUint32(nread, read, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_readdir: wrap((fd, bufPtr, bufLen, cookie, bufusedPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_READDIR);
        this.refreshMemory();
        let entries = fs.readdirSync(stats.path, { withFileTypes: !0 }), startPtr = bufPtr;
        for (let i = Number(cookie);i < entries.length; i += 1) {
          let entry = entries[i], nameLength = @Buffer.byteLength(entry.name);
          if (bufPtr - startPtr > bufLen)
            break;
          if (this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(i + 1), !0), bufPtr += 8, bufPtr - startPtr > bufLen)
            break;
          let rstats = fs.lstatSync(path.resolve(stats.path, entry.name));
          if (this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.ino), !0), bufPtr += 8, bufPtr - startPtr > bufLen)
            break;
          if (this.view.setUint32(bufPtr, nameLength, !0), bufPtr += 4, bufPtr - startPtr > bufLen)
            break;
          let filetype;
          switch (!0) {
            case rstats.isBlockDevice():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_BLOCK_DEVICE;
              break;
            case rstats.isCharacterDevice():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_CHARACTER_DEVICE;
              break;
            case rstats.isDirectory():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_DIRECTORY;
              break;
            case rstats.isFIFO():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_SOCKET_STREAM;
              break;
            case rstats.isFile():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_REGULAR_FILE;
              break;
            case rstats.isSocket():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_SOCKET_STREAM;
              break;
            case rstats.isSymbolicLink():
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_SYMBOLIC_LINK;
              break;
            default:
              filetype = WASI_FILETYPE_UNKNOWN;
              break;
          }
          if (this.view.setUint8(bufPtr, filetype), bufPtr += 1, bufPtr += 3, bufPtr + nameLength >= startPtr + bufLen)
            break;
          @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer).write(entry.name, bufPtr), bufPtr += nameLength;
        }
        let bufused = bufPtr - startPtr;
        return this.view.setUint32(bufusedPtr, Math.min(bufused, bufLen), !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_renumber: wrap((from, to) => {
        let fromEntry = CHECK_FD(from, BigInt(0)), toEntry = CHECK_FD(to, BigInt(0));
        return fs.closeSync(fromEntry.real), this.FD_MAP.set(from, toEntry), this.FD_MAP.delete(to), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_seek: wrap((fd, offset, whence, newOffsetPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_SEEK);
        switch (this.refreshMemory(), whence) {
          case WASI_WHENCE_CUR:
            stats.offset = (stats.offset ? stats.offset : BigInt(0)) + BigInt(offset);
            break;
          case WASI_WHENCE_END:
            let { size } = this.fstatSync(stats.real);
            stats.offset = BigInt(size) + BigInt(offset);
            break;
          case WASI_WHENCE_SET:
            stats.offset = BigInt(offset);
            break;
        }
        if (stats.offset == null)
          throw Error("stats.offset must be defined");
        return this.view.setBigUint64(newOffsetPtr, stats.offset, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_tell: wrap((fd, offsetPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_TELL);
        if (this.refreshMemory(), !stats.offset)
          stats.offset = BigInt(0);
        return this.view.setBigUint64(offsetPtr, stats.offset, !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      fd_sync: wrap((fd) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_FD_SYNC);
        return fs.fsyncSync(stats.real), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      path_create_directory: wrap((fd, pathPtr, pathLen) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_PATH_CREATE_DIRECTORY);
        if (!stats.path)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        this.refreshMemory();
        let p = @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer, pathPtr, pathLen).toString();
        return fs.mkdirSync(RESOLVE_PATH(stats, p)), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      path_filestat_get: wrap((fd, flags, pathPtr, pathLen, bufPtr) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_PATH_FILESTAT_GET);
        if (!stats.path)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        this.refreshMemory();
        let p = @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer, pathPtr, pathLen).toString(), resolved = RESOLVE_PATH(stats, p), rstats;
        if (flags)
          rstats = fs.statSync(resolved);
        else
          rstats = fs.lstatSync(resolved);
        return this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.dev), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.ino), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setUint8(bufPtr, translateFileAttributes(this, void 0, rstats).filetype), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.nlink), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.size), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.atime.getTime() * 1e6), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.mtime.getTime() * 1e6), !0), bufPtr += 8, this.view.setBigUint64(bufPtr, BigInt(rstats.ctime.getTime() * 1e6), !0), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      path_filestat_set_times: wrap((fd, _dirflags, pathPtr, pathLen, stAtim, stMtim, fstflags) => {
        let stats = CHECK_FD(fd, WASI_RIGHT_PATH_FILESTAT_SET_TIMES);
        if (!stats.path)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        this.refreshMemory();
        let rstats = this.fstatSync(stats.real), { atime: atim, mtime: mtim } = rstats, n = nsToMs(now(WASI_CLOCK_REALTIME)), atimflags = WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM | WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM_NOW;
        if ((fstflags & atimflags) === atimflags)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        let mtimflags = WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM | WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM_NOW;
        if ((fstflags & mtimflags) === mtimflags)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM)
          atim = nsToMs(stAtim);
        else if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM_NOW) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_ATIM_NOW)
          atim = n;
        if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM)
          mtim = nsToMs(stMtim);
        else if ((fstflags & WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM_NOW) === WASI_FILESTAT_SET_MTIM_NOW)
          mtim = n;
        let p = @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer, pathPtr, pathLen).toString();
        return fs.utimesSync(RESOLVE_PATH(stats, p), new Date(atim), new Date(mtim)), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      path_link: wrap((oldFd, _oldFlags, oldPath, oldPathLen, newFd, newPath, newPathLen) => {
        let ostats = CHECK_FD(oldFd, WASI_RIGHT_PATH_LINK_SOURCE), nstats = CHECK_FD(newFd, WASI_RIGHT_PATH_LINK_TARGET);
        if (!ostats.path || !nstats.path)
          return WASI_EINVAL;
        this.refreshMemory();
        let op = @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer, oldPath, oldPathLen).toString(), np = @Buffer.from(this.memory.buffer, newPath, newPathLen).toString();
        return fs.linkSync(RESOLVE_PATH(ostats, op), RESOLVE_PATH(nstats, np)), WASI_ESUCCESS;
      }),
      path_open: wrap((dirfd, _dirflags, pathPtr, pathLen, oflags, fsRightsBase, fsRightsInheriting, fsFlags, fdPtr) => {
        try {
          let stats = CHECK_FD(dirfd, WASI_RIGHT_PATH_OPEN);
          fsRightsBase = BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(fsRightsBase)), fsRightsInheriting = BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(fsRightsInheriting));
          let read = (fsRightsBase & (WASI_RIGHT_FD_READ | WASI_RIGHT_FD_READDIR)) !== BigInt(0), write = (fsRightsBase & (WASI_RIGHT_FD_DATASYNC | WASI_RIGHT_FD_WRITE | WASI_RIGHT_FD_ALLOCATE | WASI_RIGHT_FD_FILESTAT_SET_SIZE)) !== BigInt(0), noflags;
          if (write && read)
            noflags = nodeFsConstants.O_RDWR;
          else if (read)
            noflags = nodeFsConstants.O_RDONLY;
          else if (write)
            noflags = nodeFsConstants.O_WRONLY;
          let neededBase = fsRightsBase | WASI_RIGHT_PATH_OPEN, neededInheriting = fsRightsBase | fsRightsInheriting;
          if ((oflags & WASI_O_CREAT) !== 0)
            noflags |= nodeFsConstants.O_CREAT, neededBase |= WASI_RIGHT_PATH_CREATE_FILE;
          if ((oflags & WASI_O_DIRECTORY) !== 0)
            noflags |= nodeFsConstants.O_DIRECTORY;
          if ((oflags & WASI_O_EXCL) !== 0)
            noflags |= nodeFsConstants.O_EXCL;
          if ((oflags & WASI_O_TRUNC) !== 0)
